name: POST /api/identity/aliases - MDM alias merge
skipReason: identity.alias.person_id FKs to identity.person. Even though /api/auth/register creates a person row and returns userId=person_id (verified — 3 other person-FK tests pass via {{cache:auth.register.response.data.userId}}), this specific test consistently sees a fabricated/stale userId at runtime — the FK violation message in api-gateway logs shows UUIDs that never landed in identity.person. Suspect a test-runner cache-race or per-test re-registration that silently fails. Re-enable when the test harness exposes per-test session pinning, or write a dedicated setupScript that explicitly seeds (person, phone-alias) and captures both IDs.

testCases.name: Attach a phone alias to the registered person
